mn12:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati bahinagare avarapure vanasaṇḍe.
mn12:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Sunakkhatto Licchaviputto acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā;
mn12:2.2: so Vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ etaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
mn12:2.3: Na-tthi samaṇassa Gotamassa uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso,
mn12:2.4: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ,
mn12:2.5: yassa ca khvāssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyāti.
mn12:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn12:3.2: Assosi kho āyasmā Sāriputto Sunakkhattassa Licchaviputtassa Vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ etaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa:
mn12:3.3: Na-tthi samaṇassa Gotamassa uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso,
mn12:3.4: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ,
mn12:3.5: yassa ca khvāssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyāti.
mn12:3.6: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn12:3.7: Sunakkhatto bhante Licchaviputto acirapakkanto imasmā dhammavinayā,
mn12:3.8: so Vesāliyaṃ parisatiṃ etaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
mn12:4.2: kodhā ca pan' assa esā vācā bhāsitā.
mn12:4.3: Avaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmīti so Sāriputta Sunakkhatto moghapuriso vaṇṇaṃ yeva Tathāgatassa bhāsati. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn12:4.4: Vaṇṇo h' eso Sāriputta Tathāgatassa yo evaṃ vadeyya:

mn12:5.1: Ayam-pi hi nāma Sāriputta Sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhammanvayo na bhavissati:
mn12:5.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti.
mn12:6.1: Ayam-pi hi nāma Sāriputta Sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhammanvayo na bhavissati:
mn12:6.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhā pi hutvā eko hoti, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathā pi ākāse, paṭhaviyā pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathā pi udake, udake pi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathā pi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāse pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathā pi pakkhī sakuṇo, ime pi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati parimajjati, yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vattetīti.
mn12:7.1: Ayam-pi hi nāma Sāriputta Sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhammanvayo na bhavissati:
mn12:7.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cāti.
mn12:8.1: Ayam-pi hi nāma Sāriputta Sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhammanvayo na bhavissati:
mn12:8.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:

mn12:40.1: Idha panāhaṃ Sāriputta ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi:
mn12:40.3: tam-enaṃ passāmi . . . manussesu upapannaṃ sukhabahulā vedanā vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:40.4: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta rukkho same bhūmibhāge jāto bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo,
mn12:40.5: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ekāyanena maggena tam-eva rukkhaṃ paṇidhāya,
mn12:40.6: tam-enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya:
mn12:40.7: Tathā 'yaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ-ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā imaṃ yeva rukkhaṃ āgamissatīti;
mn12:40.8: tam-enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena tassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā sukhabahulā vedanā vediyamānaṃ;
mn12:40.9: evam-eva kho ahaṃ Sāriputta idh' ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ . . . vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:41.1: Sāriputta ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi:
mn12:41.2: Tathā 'yaṃ puggalo . . . param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissatīti;
mn12:41.3: tam-enaṃ passāmi . . . sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ ekantasukhā vedanā vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:41.4: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta pāsādo, tatr' assa kūṭāgāraṃ ullittāvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phassitaggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ,
mn12:41.5: tatr' assa pallaṅko gonakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sa-uttaracchado ubhatolohitakūpadhāno,
mn12:41.6: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ekāyanena maggena tam-eva pāsādaṃ paṇidhāya,
mn12:41.7: tam-enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya:
mn12:41.8: Tathā 'yaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ-ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā imaṃ yeva pāsādaṃ āgamissatīti;
mn12:41.9: tam-enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena tasmiṃ pāsāde tasmiṃ kūṭāgāre tasmiṃ pallaṅke nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā ekantasukhā vedanā vediyamānaṃ;
mn12:41.10: evam-eva kho ahaṃ Sāriputta idh' ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ . . . vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:42.1: Idha panāhaṃ Sāriputta ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi:
mn12:42.2: Tathā 'yaṃ puggalo paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ-ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatīti;
mn12:42.3: tam-enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantaṃ ekantasukhā vedanā vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:42.4: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setakā sūpatitthā ramaṇīyā,
mn12:42.6: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ekāyanena maggena tam-eva pokkharaṇiṃ paṇidhāya,
mn12:42.7: tam-enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya:
mn12:42.8: Tathā 'yaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ-ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā imaṃ yeva pokkharaṇiṃ āgamissatīti;
mn12:42.9: tam-enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhitvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca sabbadarathakilamathapariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambhetvā paccuttaritvā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā ekantasukhā vedanā vediyamānaṃ; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn12:42.10: evam-eva kho ahaṃ Sāriputta idh' ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi:
mn12:42.11: Tathā 'yaṃ puggalo paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ-ca maggaṃ samārūḷho yathā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatīti;
mn12:42.12: tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantaṃ ekantasukhā vedanā vediyamānaṃ.
mn12:43.1: Yo kho maṃ Sāriputta evaṃ jānantaṃ evaṃ passantaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
mn12:43.2: Na-tthi samaṇassa Gotamassa uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso,
mn12:43.3: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānan-ti,
mn12:43.4: taṃ Sāriputta vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
mn12:43.5: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno diṭṭhe va dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, evaṃsampadam-idaṃ Sāriputta vadāmi:
mn12:43.6: taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
mn12:44.1: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ Sāriputta caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā:
mn12:44.2: tapassī sudaṃ homi paramatapassī, lūkhas-sudaṃ homi paramalūkho, jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī, pavivittas-sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.
mn12:45.1: Tatra-ssu me idaṃ Sāriputta tapassitāya hoti: acelako homi muttācāro hatthāpalekhano, na ehibhadantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, nābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantaṇaṃ sādiyāmi;
mn12:45.2: so na kumbhīmukhā patigaṇhāmi, na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāmi, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā, na pāyamānāya, na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittisu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivāmi.
mn12:45.3: So ekāgāriko vā homi ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā homi dvālopiko \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ -- sattāgāriko vā homi sattālopiko.
mn12:45.4: Ekissā pi dattiyā yāpemi, dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpemi -- sattahi pi dattīhi yāpemi.
mn12:45.5: Ehāhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāremi, dvīhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāremi -- sattāhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāremi. Iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam-pi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogam-anuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:45.6: So sākabhakkho vā homi, sāmākabhakkho vā homi, nīvārabhakkho . . ., daddulabhakkho . . ., haṭabhakkho . . ., kaṇabhakkho . . ., ācāmabhakkho . . ., piññākabhakkho . . ., tiṇabhakkho . . ., gomayabhakko vā homi; vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpemi pavattaphalabhojī.
mn12:45.7: So sāṇāni pi dhāremi, masāṇāni pi dhāremi, chavadussāni pi dh., paṃsukūlāni pi dh., tirīṭāni pi dh., ajinam-pi dh., ajinakkhipam-pi dh., kusacīram-pi dh., vākacīram-pi dh., phalakacīram-pi dh., kesakambalam-pi dh., vālakambalam-pi dh., ulūkapakkham-pi dhāremi.
mn12:45.11: kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi homi kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappemi,
mn12:45.13: Iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogam-anuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:45.14: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta tapassitāya hoti.
mn12:46.1: Tatra-ssu me idaṃ Sāriputta lūkhasmiṃ hoti:
mn12:46.2: nekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti papaṭikajātaṃ.
mn12:46.3: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta tindukākhāṇu nekavassagaṇiko sannicito hoti papaṭikajāto, evam-eva-ssu me Sāriputta nekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti papaṭikajātaṃ.
mn12:46.4: Tassa mayhaṃ Sāriputta na evaṃ hoti:
mn12:46.5: Aho vatāhaṃ imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyaṃ, aññe vā pana me imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyun-ti.
mn12:46.7: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta lūkhasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:47.1: Tatra-ssu me idaṃ Sāriputta jegucchismiṃ hoti:
mn12:47.2: so kho ahaṃ Sāriputta sato va abhikkamāmi sato paṭikkamāmi, yāva udabindumhi pi me dayā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti:
mn12:47.3: mā 'haṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādessan-ti.
mn12:47.4: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta jegucchismiṃ hoti.
mn12:48.1: Tatra-ssu me idaṃ Sāriputta pavivittasmiṃ hoti:
mn12:48.2: so kho ahaṃ Sāriputta aññataraṃ araññāyatanaṃ ajjhogāhitvā viharāmi, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn12:48.3: yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā, vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatāmi,
mn12:48.5: mā maṃ te addasaṃsu ahañ-ca mā te addasan-ti.
mn12:48.6: Seyyathā pi Sāriputta araññako migo manusse disvā vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatati,
mn12:48.7: evam-eva kho ahaṃ Sāriputta yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā, vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatāmi,
mn12:48.9: mā maṃ te addasaṃsu ahañ-ca mā te addasan-ti.
mn12:48.10: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta pavivittasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:49.1: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta ye te goṭṭhā paṭṭhitagāvo apagatagopālakā tattha catukuṇḍiko upasaṅkamitvā yāni tāni vacchakānaṃ taruṇakānaṃ dhenupakānaṃ gomayāni tāni sudaṃ āhāremi.
mn12:49.2: Yāva kīvañ-ca me Sāriputta sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādiṇṇaṃ hoti, sakaṃ yeva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi.
mn12:49.3: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta mahāvikaṭabhojanasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:50.1: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta aññataraṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhitvā viharāmi.
mn12:50.2: Tatra sudaṃ Sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti:
mn12:50.3: yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti.
mn12:50.4: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta yā tā rattiyo sītā hemantikā antaraṭṭhake himapātasamaye tathārūpāsu rattisu rattiṃ abbhokāse viharāmi divā vanasaṇḍe,
mn12:50.5: gimhānaṃ pacchime māse divā abbhokāse viharāmi rattiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
mn12:50.6: Api-ssu maṃ Sāriputta ayaṃ anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhāsi pubbe assutapubbā:
mn12:51.1: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chavaṭṭhikāni upadhāya.
mn12:51.2: Api-ssu maṃ Sāriputta gomaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhanti pi omuttenti pi, paṃsukena okiranti pi, kaṇṇasotesu pi salākaṃ pavesenti.
mn12:51.3: Na kho panāhaṃ Sāriputta abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā.
mn12:51.4: Idaṃ su me Sāriputta upekhāvihārasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:52.1: Santi kho pana Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn12:52.5: te kolam-pi khādanti, kolacuṇṇam-pi khādanti, kolodakam-pi pivanti,
mn12:52.7: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ Sāriputta ekaṃ yeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āharitā.
mn12:52.8: Siyā kho pana te Sāriputta evam-assa:
mn12:52.9: mahā nūna tena samayena kolo ahosīti.
mn12:52.10: Na kho pan' etaṃ Sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ,
mn12:52.11: tadā pi etaparamo yeva kolo ahosi seyyathā pi etarahi.
mn12:52.12: Tassa mayhaṃ Sāriputta ekaṃ yeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti:
mn12:52.13: seyyathā pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kālāpabbāni vā evam-eva-ssu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya,
mn12:52.14: seyyathā pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ evameva-ssu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya,
mn12:52.15: seyyathā pi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī evam-eva-ssu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako unnatāvanato hoti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya,
mn12:52.16: seyyathā pi nāma jarasālāya gopānasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti evam-eva-ssu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya,
mn12:52.17: seyyathā pi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti evam-eva-ssu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya,
mn12:52.18: seyyathā pi nāma tittakālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena sampuṭito hoti sammilāto evam-eva-ssu me sīsacchavi sampuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy' ev' appāhāratāya.
mn12:52.19: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta: udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ yeva parigaṇhāmi, piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmīti udaracchaviṃ yeva parigaṇhāmi, yāva-ssu me Sāriputta udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya.
mn12:52.20: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta: vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tatth' eva avakujjo papatāmi tāy' ev' appāhāratāya.
mn12:52.21: So kho ahaṃ Sāriputta tam-eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi, tassa mayhaṃ Sāriputta pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāy' ev' appāhāratāya.

mn12:59.1: Santi kho pana Sāriputta eke s. e. e.:
mn12:59.3: Na kho pana so Sāriputta āvāso sulabharūpo yo mayā anāvutthapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra Suddhāvāsehi devehi;
mn12:59.4: Suddhāvāse cāhaṃ Sāriputta deve vaseyyaṃ, na-y-imaṃ lokaṃ punar-āgaccheyyaṃ.
mn12:60.1: Santi kho pana Sāriputta eke s. e. e.:
mn12:60.3: Na kho pana so Sāriputta yañño sulabharūpo yo mayā ayiṭṭhapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, tañ-ca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddhāvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
mn12:61.1: Santi kho pana Sāriputta eke s. e. e.:
mn12:61.3: Na kho pana so Sāriputto aggi sulabharūpo yo mayā apariciṇṇapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā. tañ-ca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddhāvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
mn12:62.1: Santi kho pana Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn12:62.2: yāvad-evāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā, tāvad-eva paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgato hoti;
mn12:62.3: yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto. asītiko vā navutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā parihāyatīti.
mn12:62.4: Na kho pan, etaṃ Sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabaṃ.
mn12:62.5: Ahaṃ kho pana Sāriputta etarahi jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto, asītiko me vayo vattati.
mn12:62.6: Idha me assu Sāriputta cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukāvassasatajīvino paramāya satiyā ca gatiyā ca dhitiyā ca samannāgatā paramena ca paññāveyyattiyena;
mn12:62.7: seyyathā pi Sāriputta daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasiren' eva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ; atipāteyya,
mn12:62.8: evaṃ adhimattasatimanto evaṃ adhimattagatimanto evaṃ adhimattadhitimanto evaṃ paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgatā. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn12:62.9: Te maṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ upādāy' upādāya pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ. puṭṭho puṭṭho cāhaṃ tesaṃ byākareyyaṃ, byākatañ-ca me byākatato dhāreyyuṃ, na ca maṃ dutiyakaṃ uttariṃ paripuccheyyuṃ,
mn12:62.10: aññatra asita-pītakhāyita-sāyitā, aññatra uccārapassāvakammā, aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā. Apariyādiṇṇā yev' assa Sāriputta Tathāgatassa dhammadesanā, apariyādiṇṇaṃ yev' assa Tathāgatassa dhammapadabyañjanaṃ, apariyādiṇṇaṃ yev' assa Tathāgatassa pañhapaṭibhānaṃ,
mn12:62.11: atha me te cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino vassasatassa accayena kālaṃ kareyyuṃ.
mn12:62.12: Mañcakena ce pi maṃ Sāriputta pariharissatha n' ev' atthi Tathāgatassa paññāveyyattiyassa aññathattaṃ.
mn12:63.1: Yaṃ kho taṃ Sāriputta sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn12:63.2: asammohadhammo satto loke uppanno bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan-ti, mam-eva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
mn12:64.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgasamālo Bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti Bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
mn12:64.2: Atha kho āyasmā Nāgasamālo Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn12:64.4: api ca me bhante imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā lomāni haṭṭhāni.
mn12:64.6: Tasmātiha tvaṃ Nāgasamāla imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ Lomahaṃsanapariyāyo t' eva naṃ dhārehīti.
mn12:64.8: Attamano āyasmā Nāgasamālo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 13.
